title: Friction-Augmented Drifting Models for Resource-Efficient Domain Translation
abstract: arXiv:2604.18194v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Single-step generators promise high-fidelity synthesis at a fraction of the inference and training cost of ordinary differential equation (ODE)-based flow models, a central concern when compute is limited. Drifting Models (DMs) train a one-step generator by evolving samples under a kernel-based drift field, avoiding ODE integration entirely, but a two-particle surrogate of their iteration admits a \emph{locally repulsive} regime in which repulsion can dominate the attraction to the target. We introduce DMF (Drifting Model with Friction), which scales the drift field by a linearly-scheduled coefficient $1-\gamma(i)$. A closed-form analysis of the surrogate gives a per-step contraction threshold and a finite-horizon bound on the error trajectory, suggesting why friction can halt the iteration before it relaxes to a spurious force-balance fixed point. On FFHQ latent-space domain translation, DMF significantly improves on the frictionles

translated_title: 摩擦增强漂移模型用于资源高效的域转换
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.18194v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：单步生成器承诺以普通微分方程（ODE）为基础的流模型推理和训练成本的一小部分实现高保真合成，这在计算受限时是一个核心关注点。漂移模型（DMs）通过在基于核的漂移场下演化样本来训练单步生成器，完全避免了ODE积分，但其迭代的双粒子替代物允许一个“局部排斥”区域，其中排斥力可能主导对目标的吸引力。我们引入了DMF（带摩擦的漂移模型），它通过线性调度的系数$1-\gamma(i)$缩放漂移场。对替代物的闭式分析给出了每步收缩阈值和误差轨迹的有限时域界限，这解释了为什么摩擦可以在迭代松弛到虚假力平衡固定点之前停止迭代。在FFHQ潜在空间域转换中，DMF显著优于无摩擦版本。
tldr: 本文提出了一种带摩擦的漂移模型（DMF），通过线性调度的系数缩放漂移场，在域转换中防止迭代陷入虚假力平衡，从而显著提升性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Friction-Augmented Drifting Model (DMF) that scales the drift field with a linearly-scheduled coefficient, preventing iteration from relaxing to a spurious force-balance fixed point and significantly improving domain translation performance.
